name: LYOPHILIZER
desc: Premium Floor-Standing Laboratory Freeze Dryer (Lyophilizer) engineered for high-performance sublimation and sample preservation. Features a 6-liter ice-condensing capacity with an ultra-low condenser cooling threshold reaching down to -80°C and a 7-inch interactive color touchscreen display.
features: 6 Litre volumetric vapor trapping collection capacity
Ultra-low thermal cooling performance reaching down to -80°C
7 Inch large color interactive Touch Screen Display panel
Real-time integrated dynamic graphing array for drying cycle analysis
High-efficiency automated Electric Heating defrost system

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Floor Standing Laboratory Freeze Dryer (Lyophilizer)
specifications.Primary Process Mechanism: Cold trap sublimation drying for biological sample preservation
specifications.Ice Condenser Capacity: 6 Litre volumetric vapor trapping collection capacity
specifications.Condenser Temperature Threshold: Ultra-low thermal cooling performance reaching down to minus 80 degree C
specifications.User Operator Interface: 7 Inch large color interactive Touch Screen Display panel
specifications.Visual Process Monitoring: Real-time concurrent tracking display of condenser temp, sample temp, and vacuum level
specifications.Data Visualization Engine: Real-time integrated dynamic graphing array for drying cycle analysis
specifications.Vacuum Regulation Control: High-precision interactive Vacuum Control functionality integration
specifications.Pressure Tracking Tools: Integrated industrial-grade high-precision vacuum gauge system
specifications.Calibration Diagnostics: Built-in vacuum and temperature software correction loops for long-term accuracy
specifications.Defrosting Operational Mode: High-efficiency automated Electric Heating defrost system
specifications.Power Supply Safeguards: Intelligent Power-off Auto-recovery function with user-defined restart timers
specifications.Operational Protection Alarms: Comprehensive multi-parameter built-in audio-visual alarms preventing mis-operation
specifications.Pump Operational Safety: Programmable automated vacuum pump start/stop link based on condenser temperature
specifications.Environmental Pump Accessory: High-performance integrated Oil Mist Filter assembly safeguarding indoor air
specifications.Door Assembly Architecture: Heavy-duty Single Door structural compression lock layout
specifications.Chassis Fabrication Material: Industrial-grade heavy-gauge Mild Steel (MS) rigid chassis shell
specifications.Mobility Infrastructure: Ultra-smooth industrial caster wheels with dedicated foot locking stability jacks
specifications.Total Electrical Power Load: Optimized electrical footprint drawing up to 2 kW peak consumption
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 230 V AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable electrical connection
specifications.Target Application Fields: Molecular Biology, Vaccine Production, Pathology Labs, and Pharma R and D
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on compressor and vacuum loop
